summary: RptMnuReport_Wizards is a user control in the HSPnet application that manages the functionality related to report wizards. It interacts with a GridView and a data source to manage and display wizard-related data.
purpose: The purpose of the RptMnuReport_Wizards control is to facilitate the display and selection of report wizards available to the user, allowing them to navigate to specific wizard interfaces for report generation.

fields.name: gridData
fields.description: A web control for displaying wizard information.

fields.name: dsWizards
fields.description: A data source control to manage the retrieval of wizard data.

fields.name: UserSession
fields.description: Stores the session information of the current user.

fields.name: blnPlacingUser
fields.description: Indicates if the session user is a placing user.

fields.name: blnReceivingUser
fields.description: Indicates if the session user is a receiving user.

actors.name: UserSession
actors.description: Represents the current user's session interacting with the report wizards.

workflows.name: Data Selection
steps: If null, cancel the data selection operation.
If not null, set input parameters for session and user types into the data selection event.

workflows.name: Row Command Execution
steps: Capture the command name from the GridView control.
If the command is 'cmdWizards', cache the current user session.
Redirect the user to the 'ReportWizardMenu.aspx' page with the appropriate session query string and Wizard ID.

system_behavior: The control cancels data operations if no user session is found.
Allows navigation to wizard-specific pages if a command is executed on the grid.
dependencies: GridView and ObjectDataSource for data presentation and manipulation.
exceptions: Operations are canceled if UserSession is not available.
